register_plugin_class: register a custom Hydra plugin class with Plugins.instance().register(MyPlugin)
discover_plugins: discover all registered plugins of a given type using Plugins.instance().discover(Launcher)
instantiate_sweeper: instantiate a Hydra sweeper plugin from config using Plugins.instance().instantiate_sweeper
instantiate_launcher: instantiate a Hydra launcher plugin from config using Plugins.instance().instantiate_launcher
get_scan_stats: get plugin scan timing stats using Plugins.instance().get_stats() to inspect import performance
